India Opens Hockey World Cup with Win Against Wales

The Indian men's hockey team defeated Wales 3-1 in their opening match of the FIH Hockey World Cup 2026. The team, led by Harmanpreet Singh, aims to end a 51-year medal drought in the tournament. Veteran player Manpreet Singh indicated that this World Cup could be his last. The new tournament format has been highlighted as having no scope for slip-ups, potentially posing a challenge for favored teams.
